snippet.title: Soul card duel trailer
snippet.description: A 2D tactical roguelite deckbuilder where direction and positioning create deeper gameplay. Explore procedural maps, build your hero and deck, master positional card-based combat, and evolve your gear with thousands of combinations to compete in the ultimate tournament. https://store.steampowered.com/app/3938290/Soul_Card_Duel/
